Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a '''bounty hunter''' was working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was hired by the Empire to track down [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], believed to be in hiding on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Alongside [[Unidentified female bounty hunter|another hunter]], the hunter was present when an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team found [[Dana (Rebel Alliance)|Dana]], an Alliance agent, dead at the feet of Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Voor (lieutenant)|Voor]]. The humanoid was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the ensuing skirmish.<ref name="TM" />

The hunter was tall and scaly, and armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] and [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="TM" />
